title: Outdoor city. Indoor weekend.
why: Brand-belief piece for visitors planning an Austin weekend: the river runs through downtown and most people never touch it. The water should be an afternoon decision, not a planned excursion.
hook_options: You did Rainey, SoCo and the bat bridge. You never touched the river.
Austin's best view has no line
caption: Rainey Street. South Congress. Barton Springs, packed. Bats from the bridge, standing room only. Then the airport. The river runs through the middle of all of it and most visitors never get on it. Give it one afternoon. 4 in 10 of our recent guests booked same-day. #visitaustin #ladybirdlake #austinweekend #austinkayaktours

slides.headline: Outdoor city. Indoor weekend.
slides.body: Most visitors spend the whole trip on patios and sidewalks. The river runs through the middle of it the entire time.

slides.headline: Rainey Street. South Congress. Fly home.
slides.body: Barton Springs, packed. Bats from the bridge, standing room only. Then a patio. Then the airport.

slides.headline: Everyone faces the water. Nobody's on it.
slides.body: Hundreds of people on the grass, watching the lake from the outside.

slides.headline: The water is right there
slides.body: Lady Bird Lake is about a 10-minute drive from most of town. You don't need a free weekend. You need a free afternoon.

slides.headline: The skyline from the angle locals skip
slides.body: One reviewer: "Saw a side of the city we would've completely missed otherwise."

slides.headline: It's not the Hill Country
slides.body: No wilderness, no rapids, no epic portage. It's a calm urban paddle that happens to be beautiful. That's plenty.

slides.headline: Graffiti, bridges, turtles, skyline
slides.body: That mix is the point. You paddle through the city instead of driving away from it.

slides.headline: Decide at 11. Paddle at 2.
slides.body: About 4 in 10 of our recent bookings were same-day. We didn't plan that. It's just how Austin decides things.

slides.headline: Give the river one afternoon
slides.body: Two hours between brunch and dinner. Guide, kayak, life vest. You'll go back to the patio with a better story.

slides.kicker: Send this to the trip group chat
slides.headline: Austin is outside. Go use it.
slides.body: Skyline and sunset tours on Lady Bird Lake. Book at austinkayaktours.com.
